g.text: Appendix. Full support and class-specific performance
RECORDED RESPONSES + CLASS-CONDITIONAL MODEL | Use the full city range and inspect the five Ducks species.
All curves average over fixed observed items. Every city item has at least 97 votes; every Ducks image has 40.
Class-specific curves for all datasets and matched class-conditional model curves are included in the accompanying CSV tables.
